content.heading: Interim measures, etc., by Court
content.text: A party may, before or during arbitral proceedings or at any time after the making of the arbitral award but before it is enforced in accordance with section 36, apply to a court for interim measures of protection, including appointment of a guardian, preservation or interim custody of the subject-matter, securing the amount in dispute, detention or inspection of property, interim injunction, and appointment of a receiver. Once the tribunal is constituted, the court shall not entertain an application under this section unless it finds that circumstances exist which may not render the remedy under section 17 efficacious.
